entries.claim: Finding 1 remains open: the scheme lookbehind does not bound retry starts because it rejects only starts preceded by a letter, while the scheme continuation class also accepts digits, `+`, `.`, and `-`.
entries.failure_scenario: A segment such as `'1a'.repeat(240000) + ':///@'` passes the `://` and `@` pre-checks. Every `a` is preceded by `1`, so every candidate passes `(?<![A-Za-z])`; each attempt scans the remaining alternating run to the common `://` and then fails when userinfo begins with the extra slash. The engine therefore performs quadratically many character visits despite the new fence.

entries.claim: Finding 2 is only fixed for zero-versus-nonzero observability; `redactions` still does not count the spans removed.
entries.failure_scenario: For `https://<redacted>:one@h/a https://<redacted>:two@h/b`, two credential spans are replaced, but each consumes one existing marker and emits one marker. The before and after marker counts are both two, so `net` is zero and the floor reports `redactions: 1` in the envelope and trace even though two spans were redacted.
